artifacts.note: Runner reports/screenshots are ignored local artifacts; this tracked summary records successful results.

limits: Animation frames are controlled in ranked acceptance; UTC, timers, auth, storage and backend verification are real. Network loss/quota faults are explicitly injected.
429/503/expiry queue edge behavior is covered by coordinator unit tests and backend integration; this does not claim a physical-device outage trial.
Public boards are live; refresh from the first page when ranks move.
Unsaved completion recovery requires the open page, a retained matching replay, or a completed Daily checkpoint; clearing device data loses device-only work.
Actual-device/YouTube certification, moderation/telemetry/operations/backup/restore and production rollout remain later gates.
